analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI is attempting to move out of oversold territory but remains in neutral, and MACD histogram is improving but still in negative territory with weak convergence. Trading volume is also subdued at 0.58x the 5-day average, making a trend reversal uncertain.
